name: @chaibialaa/orchestrator
description: A driving loop for coding agents: a judge decides, an agent executes, a proof settles it. Cost, deliverables and progress are derived from the traces — never declared.

scripts.prerelease-guard:
node -e "const v=require('./package.json').version, t=process.env.npm_config_tag||'latest'; if(v.includes('-')&&t==='latest'){console.error('
  '+v+' is a pre-release and would be published as the default version.
  publishConfig.tag is NOT honoured by this npm, so it has to be on the command:

    npm publish --tag beta
');process.exit(1)}"
scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run prerelease-guard && npm run build && npm test

author: Chaibi Alaa
